items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: before I joined the band, he had had such luminaries as Nick Kaspian was with him.

ctx.x: But he didn't play any more. He stood in front of it. He had a little waxed moustache and to us, he was old. But we were all young kids. He was a territory band leader, and he had done -- before I joined the band, he had had such luminaries as Nick Kaspian was with him.
